TITLE: Your eyes have a boss too?
NEXT: NEXT: The same color, but it looks different?

EN.두 손을 겹쳐\n세모 구멍을 만들어요:
Put your hands together
to make a triangle-shaped hole
EN.팔을 뻗고, 두 눈으로\n먼 물건을 구멍 가운데에:
Stretch out your arms and, with both eyes,
put a far-away object in the middle of the hole
EN.그리고 한쪽씩 눈을 감아요: Then close one eye at a time
EN.두 눈을 뜨고\n물건을 구멍 가운데에:
Both eyes open,
object in the middle of the hole
EN.물건이 그대로일 때\n뜨고 있던 눈 = 주인 눈!:
The eye that was open when the object stayed put
= your boss eye!
EN.물건을 구멍에 맞출 때\n뇌는 한쪽 눈을 기준으로 해요:
When you line up the object with the hole,
your brain goes by one eye
EN.다른 눈으로 보면\n구멍 밖으로 빗나가요:
Seen from the other eye,
it misses the hole
EN.오른손잡이 · 왼손잡이처럼 눈도\n주로 쓰는 쪽이 있어요:
Just like being right- or left-handed,
you have an eye you use more
EN.오른눈이 주인인 사람이\n더 많아요:
More people have
a right boss eye
EN.망원경이나 카메라를 볼 때\n저절로 주인 눈을 대요:
When you look through a telescope or camera,
you use your boss eye without thinking
EN.내 주인 눈은 어느 쪽이었나요?: Which side was your boss eye?
